business_summary: Shivam Autotech Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of auto transmission components for original equipment manufacturers in India and internationally. The company offers transmission gears and shafts; spline shafts; plungers; pinions; industrial and wind turbine gears; and power tool, power train, aluminium forged and machine, alternator, starter motor, aerospace, home appliances, electronic power steering, diesel injection system, e-rickshaw axle, EPS, magneto, steering, and various precision engineering components. It is also involved in industrial components, renewable energy equipment, power-sector components, and construction tools business. The company serves passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, tractors, construction equipment, renewable energy applications, electric three-wheelers, and select nonautomotive industrial sectors. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India. Shivam Autotech Limited operates as a subsidiary of Dayanand Munjal Investments Private Limited.
